notes.title: Demo update v1.0.0c
notes.content:
A minor demo update to fix some stuff. Version 1.0.0c changes the following:

Fix: challenge "Laser Run I" is now working - previously players could not start this challenge due to some missing content in demo

Tweak: reduced Infernal Skeleton Max HP from 100 to 75 - they can appear on first level and were a bit too difficult for new players

Content: added "Liquid Speed" Artifact to the content available in demo

notes.title: Demo is now available to download!
notes.content:
Demo is OUT!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697432/a64543106c2bd0251f3428946de5d9fcd60a5c34.jpg"]

Hey there, long time no see ^^

Today the official (and new) version of Roll The Bones demo is out! Try the game out before it's release in Q4 2025.

What's waiting for you?

F-Rank Training Gate to get you up to speed on spellcasting

Rat King's Lair - first full D-Rank gate featuring 6 floors and a boss battle

10 Challenge Gates differing in difficulty levels - from D-rank to A-rank

Handpicked selection of 21 unique Spell-Dice and 8 Artifacts

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697432/1bc2333b7cbab7a47d114d8956222bbfa198a544.jpg"]
So what to expect in full version?
More content. Way more.

Full game will feature:

several, multi-floor dungeon gates, each with a unique boss and different selection of enemies

a ton of challenge gates requiring different skills to complete them

more Spell-Dice and Artifacts - demo is just a small selection of what's to come

different playable characters and character skins
Time to play
Download the demo from Steam page, play a bit and join my Discord (https://discord.gg/rnuNPCnGDK) to leave some feedback! I'm always listening for suggestions :D

Also please drop a wishlist for the game on it's Steam page if you're interested in the full release - it helps a ton!



~Shrimp
